summary: Isabela 6th District representative with 162 principal-authored bills. Authored abolition of the corporate minimum tax, presidential power to cut petroleum taxes, an emergency Kalinga program, crop insurance, compassionate leave, an anti-dynasty ban, party-list reform, child-safety standards online and firearm-storage accountability.
caveat: Child-safety and firearm bills were not scored (single or unreviewed). Party-list reform direction judged from title only.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Corporate minimum tax abolition and fuel-tax cut power (+2) against compassionate leave (-1) and crop insurance and an inflation emergency program (-2). Balanced.
